line.title: Bonded Chassis — Five Forms
line.tagline: Aethelgard logic at walking scale · one line · met, not made
line.thesis: Rare grown shells that partner with a mind. Bond is the architecture.
line.role: Master Fashion Artist · Visual Commons · form study locks
operatingLaw: Use warms · neglect attenuates · force rejects
Attunement is mutual · strain is remembered
No chassis farm · no conscription · no scale production
Outsiders asking robots? → bonded shells and worn interfaces
There is no catalog. Only encounters.
lawLines: There is no catalog. Only encounters.
An interface is not a control.

sharedDna.origin: Grown from rare substrates, tuned to one mind
sharedDna.behavior: Shell learns, echoes, withers without bond
sharedDna.exit: Good bonds allow exit without murdering continuity
sharedDna.finish: Lived-in, scarred, specific — never factory-clean catalog poses
sharedDna.colorLanguage: Charcoal / iron / bone + violet protonic glow
neverGlobal: joystick / remote-control cosplay as primary interface

relatedSystems: Echo Chip Slot — same wafers dock non-cranial into chassis
Core Tender Gauntlets — Vault Wader especially partners with tenders
Living Ships / Oni — same bond philosophy, different scale
Aethelgard — the ship is the extreme form; these are walking cousins
line.interfaceDoctrine: A worn interface is not decoration — it is a question, a habit, a memory, a scar, a song. You wear it. It wears with you. It remembers why.
line.visualTone: Dark, wet, lived-in city. Creature + armor + grief + purpose. Each form should feel like a person met once in the rain and never forgotten.

forms.title: Vault Wader
forms.role: Deep strata · sealed ways · silent keeper of thresholds
forms.mood: threshold guardian · cathedral of pressure · patience as weapon

lock.silhouette: Massive sealed pressure-rated presence; thick plate / living alloy that reads geological; low center of gravity; recessed sensors; little social face; high-torque stance; moves like weight with purpose — slow, sure, unstoppable
lock.colors: Deep charcoal, iron, bone-plate; violet protonic glow only in recessed seams and palm dock — never full-body paint
lock.rainLogic: Built for sealed wet and acid air more than street splash; outer plate sheds; seals hold under pressure; rain on plate is incidental, not fashion
lock.repair: Bond-scar mends preferred over cosmetic polish; plate patches legal if lived-in; factory-new plate is a red flag
lock.accents: Heavy palm / gauntlet dock as primary accent scar; rune-adjacent marks at threshold seals; pulse veins low and deep
lock.interface: Heavy palm / gauntlet dock for Core Tender handshake — mutual attunement contact, not a remote control. Interface remembers sealed doors and who was trusted.
lock.bondWear: Interface is a scarred handshake habit. Strain shows as heat-memory in the palm plate. Neglect cools the pulse veins first.
lock.coverage: Full sealed endurance body; sensors recessed; social face minimized by design
lock.motion: Slow deliberate gait; high torque; never skittish; patience as weapon

forms.title: Street Echo
forms.role: Urban pulse · unseen routes · city as skin
forms.mood: ghost courier of the grid · neon rain · "I know a way"

lock.silhouette: Mid-height flexible rain-slick silhouette; soft face option or hooded social mask; quiet joints; footfalls that disappear into neon and puddle; urban mid-scale presence
materials: light wrist and collar port plates
lock.colors: Wet charcoal and iron; violet only as thin pulse in seams and collar port; neon exists as street reflection, not painted identity
lock.rainLogic: Street rain is native environment; slick outer sheds; hood/mask seals splash; puddle work without loud seals popping
lock.repair: Scuffs and alley scrapes stay; re-skin panels legal; glossy new is wrong for this form
lock.accents: Light wrist port + collar port; street-cadence Echo Chip kinship at collar; subtle rune-adjacent route marks only if lived
lock.interface: Light wrist / collar port — high social bandwidth contact. Not a leash collar. Cadence and trust, not command broadcast.
lock.bondWear: Interface wears like a habit of routes remembered. Crowd rhythm attunement; strain remembers bad alleys and forced paths.
lock.coverage: Full urban shell with optional soft face; social readability without service-droid grin
lock.motion: Quiet high-bandwidth gait; disappears into foot traffic; never stomps

forms.title: Kagekou Shell
forms.role: Shadow-bound · silence is the bond · seen only if it chooses
forms.mood: living negative space · kage (shadow) · choice to be unseen

lock.silhouette: Low profile; folded limbs; cloak / filament drape that drinks light; shadow face — voids and violet pinlights, not a friendly mask; silhouette that unravels at the periphery
lock.colors: Near-black charcoal and iron void; violet only as pinlights and rare seam breath; no bright panels
lock.rainLogic: Night rain is cover; drape sheds quietly; no reflective status chrome; wet makes it harder to read, not shinier to sell
lock.repair: Mends should stay matte and low-obs; shiny patch = failure of the form's law
lock.accents: Violet pinlights in shadow face; Oni-kin edge language without logo; Echo Veil chip affinity near contact plate
lock.interface: Near-invisible contact plate; Echo Veil chip affinity. Silence is the language. No command gauntlet theater.
lock.bondWear: Interface is almost not there — a choice to be felt. Strain is remembered as unwanted visibility. Force rejects.
lock.coverage: Full low-profile cloak-body; face is void, not smile; limbs fold small
lock.motion: Never loud; never first; always last out; footprint-light
never: first-in combat hero framing as default

forms.title: Courier
forms.role: Between hands and doors · long-road partner
forms.whisper: Carries more than parcels. Forgets nothing of the route.
forms.mood: road loyalty · salt air · "I got it there"

lock.silhouette: Pack-frame silhouette — modular back / hip load path; balanced for distance; efficient gait; weather seal; hard-use joints; straps and latches as lived wear; practical, not ornamental
lock.colors: Salt-iron charcoal and bone; violet protonic pulse in worn seams and collar dock only
lock.rainLogic: Long-road rain and salt air; seals on pack and joints; cargo stays dry; outer shows miles
lock.repair: Straps, latches, joint sleeves re-worn and replaced; route scars legal; clean courier-corp newness is wrong
lock.accents: Modular load latches; Streetcadence / Wayfinder Echo Chip at collar optional; palm pass plate polished only by use
lock.interface: Cargo handshake + palm pass; trust is the OS. Collar chip for cadence/wayfinding — assist, not override.
lock.bondWear: Interface remembers every door, code, shortcut, and who was kind. Neglect attenuates route memory first.
lock.coverage: Full weather body + modular cargo path; face practical, not decorative
lock.motion: Efficient long gait; balanced under load; never fragile fashion walk
never: status LED route display as billboard

forms.title: Mourning
forms.role: Grief-shaped · unasked witness · holds what remains when names are gone
forms.mood: funeral of light · soft thunder · "I will remember for you"

lock.silhouette: Elongated veiled form; soft fabric-like living film over structure; lantern or soft violet wick at the hand; slow processional gait — deliberately not efficient; ceremony in the body
materials: soft violet wick or lantern hand
lock.colors: Bone, soft charcoal, iron undertone; funeral violet only as wick / soft palm resonance — never combat glow
lock.rainLogic: Memorial rain is part of the rite; film sheds softly; wick sheltered by hand curve; weather does not rush the gait
lock.repair: Mends should stay soft and matte; over-polished mourning form is a violation of mood; scars of witness are not shame
lock.accents: Lantern or soft violet wick at hand; open palm; no gauntlet, no command hardware
lock.interface: Open-palm resonance only — no command gauntlet. Ever. Interface is invitation to remember, not to order.
lock.bondWear: Interface holds what remains when names are gone. Strain is remembered as forced labor attempts — and rejected. Never conscripted.
lock.coverage: Full veiled body; soft edges; no weapon silhouette; presence without threat display
lock.motion: Processional; slow; deliberately inefficient; holds silence without demanding it
